# tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_filters (Data Source)

Lists the protocol filters available to Sentry tunnel firewall rules (Minecraft Java, FiveM, TCP Generic, …).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_filters" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `filters` (Attributes List) The filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Read-Only:

- `human_name` (String) Display name, e.g. `Minecraft Java`.
- `id` (Number) Filter id, for `tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_firewall_rule.filter_id`.
- `internal_name` (String) Machine name, e.g. `mc`.
